name: Preflight Validation Hooks
description: Safety checks for bot runtime / trading logic edits. NOTE: no agent runtime auto-loads .github/hooks/ — wire these commands into your tooling (or run them manually) before relying on them. FILE_PATH must be provided by the invoking runtime as an env var; hooks that receive paths on stdin JSON should extract it before invoking.

PreToolUse.command: bash -c 'FILE_PATH="${CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS:-$FILE_PATH}"; first=$(printf "%s" "$FILE_PATH" | awk "{print \$1}"); if [[ "$first" =~ src/(trading|api|bot_instance_manager|main_instance)\.py ]]; then echo "Preflight: Checking syntax for $first"; err=$( .venv/bin/python -m py_compile "$first" 2>&1 ); rc=$?; printf "%s\n" "$err" | head -20; if [[ $rc -ne 0 ]]; then exit 1; fi; fi'
PreToolUse.description: Validate Python syntax for runtime files (fails closed on py_compile error)

PostToolUse.command: bash -c 'FILE_PATH="${CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS:-$FILE_PATH}"; first=$(printf "%s" "$FILE_PATH" | awk "{print \$1}"); if [[ "$first" =~ src/.*\.py ]]; then echo "Preflight: Running AST parse for $first"; if ! .venv/bin/python -c "import ast,sys; ast.parse(open(sys.argv[1]).read())" "$first" 2>&1; then echo "ERROR: Syntax check failed"; exit 1; fi; fi'
PostToolUse.description: Validate AST parsing after edits (fails closed on parse error)
